# Cost estimate – 200 and 500 customers (Stage 8)

Monthly figures in USD, on-demand **list** prices (as of 2026-11, region factor 1.12 for asia-south1), **indicative planning estimates, not quotes** – validate with the Pricing Calculator / Billing Catalog API and negotiated discounts (T-CO1). Counts come from the capacity model; sizing and usage are the illustrative inputs of [`cost/cost-model.yaml`](../cost/cost-model.yaml). *Optimised* applies 3-year commitments to the steady prd base (Cloud SQL, Autopilot, Cloud Run min instances, MIG VMs) and office-hours scale-down of dev/stg.
